final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) as sum_amt_minus_spent FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75 GROUP BY category), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(sum_amt_minus_spent) as avg_sum FROM step1) SELECT step1.category, step1.avg_remaining, step1.sum_amt_minus_spent, step1.sum_amt_minus_spent - step2.avg_sum as difference FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.sum_amt_minus_spent > step2.avg_sum
